assets.notes: Log-log flow rate vs pressure drop chart for superheated steam at 13 bar (ga) and 270°C. Flow rate axes on both left (kg/h) and right (kg/s) sides; x-axis shows pressure drop Δp in bar/100 m length. Multiple diagonal pipe-diameter lines annotated across the chart with a bold stepped line indicating a worked example or design envelope.
